FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(JURU-JALAN DUTA-BUKIT RAJA EXPRESSWAY, NORTH SOUTH EXPRESSWAY

CENTRAL LINK AND KUALA LUMPUR-JOHORE BAHRU EXPRESSWAY)

(AMENDMENT) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads (Private

Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Juru-Jalan Duta-Bukit Raja Expressway, North South

Expressway Central Link and Kuala Lumpur-Johore Bahru Expressway)

(Amendment) Order 2014.

 (2) Subsubparagraph 2(a)(iii), subparagraph 2(b), paragraphs 4 and 5 and

subparagraph 6(c) come into operation on 9 January 2014.

(3) Subsubparagraphs 2(a)(i) and (ii) are deemed to have come into

operation on 12 January 2012.

 (4) Subsubparagraph 3(a)(i), subparagraph 3(b) and subparagraph 6(a) are

deemed to have come into operation on 1 January 2010.

 (5) Subsubparagraph 3(a)(ii) and subparagraph 6(b) are deemed to have

come into operation on 15 January 2011.

(6) Imposition and collection of toll rates—

(a) for class 1 to class 4 as specified in PART B of the Third Schedule

are from 14 July 2009 until 31 December 2015; and

(b) for class 5 as specified in PART B of the Third Schedule—

(i) from 14 July 2009 until 14 January 2011 is as specified in

The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of

Tolls) (Juru-Jalan Duta-Bukit Raja Expressway, North South

Expressway Central Link and Kuala Lumpur-Johore Bahru

Expressway) (Amendment) (No. 3) Order 2009

(ii) from 15 January 2011 until 31 December 2015 is as

specified in subsubparagraph 3(a)(ii) of this Order.
